description: This file defines a Python class 'LocalVectorStore' that manages a FAISS-based vector index, allowing adding, searching, saving, loading, and retrieving statistics of vector embeddings with associated metadata.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class that provides methods to manage a FAISS-based vector index, including adding embeddings, searching, saving/loading index and metadata, and retrieving statistics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension, creating a FAISS index and an empty metadata list.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings and their associated metadata to the index, with dimension validation.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for a query embedding, with optional filtering by chapter, returning top-k results.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the FAISS index and metadata to disk at the specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the FAISS index and metadata from disk, returning success status.

methods.name: get_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and total metadata entries.
